componentSpecs.name: KnexLeaveTypeRepository
componentSpecs.description: Knex-based implementation of ILeaveTypeRepository. Uses a Knex instance (configured from DATABASE_URL) to perform CRUD operations on the leave_types table. Methods: findAll (returns all leave types, no isActive filter), findById, findByCode (lookup by unique code), create (inserts a new LeaveType row). Constructor accepts an optional Knex instance; if none provided, creates one from process.env.DATABASE_URL.

componentSpecs.name: knexfile.ts
componentSpecs.description: Knex configuration file at project root. Reads DATABASE_URL from environment (via dotenv). Exports a Knex.Config with: client 'pg', connection from DATABASE_URL, migrations directory './migrations' with TypeScript support, seeds directory './seeds'. Used by Knex CLI for migrate:latest, migrate:rollback, seed:run.

componentSpecs.name: leave.model.ts (LeaveType)
componentSpecs.description: Defines the LeaveType interface with fields: id (string), code (string), label (string), description (string), isActive (boolean), createdAt (Date), updatedAt (Date). This is the initial domain model file for the leave module; future phases will add LeaveRequest, LeaveBalance, and related DTOs to this same file.

componentSpecs.name: 001_create_leave_types migration
componentSpecs.description: Knex migration file at migrations/001_create_leave_types.ts. Up: creates leave_types table with columns id (uuid PK, default uuid_generate_v4()), code (varchar, unique, not null), label (varchar, not null), description (text), is_active (boolean, default true), created_at (timestamptz, default now()), updated_at (timestamptz, default now()). Down: drops the leave_types table.
